findings.reason: Pasion JOSE uses elliptic-curve 0.13 and crypto-bigint 0.5.5. The fixed 0.7.6 API is incompatible. A coordinated upstream cryptography migration is required; this is an open side-channel risk, not a non-applicability claim.

RustSec now lists patched rsa >=0.10.0. The locked 0.9.10 remains vulnerable pending a coordinated RSA/hash/key-format trait migration and JOSE/keystore round-trip validation. Reviewed JOSE signs/verifies JWTs; no RSA padding decryption call was found. This is not a non-applicability claim: broader private-key timing risk remains unresolved.
